active.title: Release-candidates system: open-scope release, closed-scope candidates
active.description: Redesign of release governance to end version/branch slop: exactly one live release named last-published-PyPI+1-patch with ONE live feature branch until deploy; the release has OPEN scope and grows by stacking candidates; each candidate is a full closed-scope SDD cycle (grill -> SPEC/PLAN/TASKS Aprovado -> implementation -> memory -> closure -> feature->develop PR merge); after each merge the agent asks promote-or-continue; continue archives the root trio into specs/releases/<v>/rc-N/ via a new `dadaia release rc-archive` verb and a fresh trio is born at root; promote runs the ship lane and only then the version increments and the next branch is cut. RELEASE.json renamed _RELEASE.json everywhere (including _archive); the scaffolded segment lane (alpha-N) is retired; at deploy the final trio stays at root and the whole folder archives. Rulings: ADRs 0005-0009.

intents.change: one filename decider _RELEASE.json; per-candidate phase cycle; rc counter as archived-candidate count
releases/<v>/rc-N/{SPEC,PLAN,TASKS}.md admitted as archive entries; segment lane entries retired; _RELEASE.json replaces RELEASE.json
segment scaffolding lane deleted; rc-N is only an archive, never scaffolded ahead
new rc-archive verb (deterministic candidate archival); release new creates the new shape and refuses a second live release
